title: AirVehicleTelemetryItem
description: One entry of a region's AirVehicleTelemetry array: all fields of the MAPI airVehicle telemetry (as sent by MAPI), with the drone's RTSP video URLs and the epoch-ms timestamp of the last change merged in.

videoUrls.description: RTSP stream URLs for this drone, derived from MAPI getConfiguration sensors.

timestampLastChanged.description: Epoch-ms of the last time this item's data changed.
